sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Oliceridine is not marketed in the United States. No information is available on the use of oliceridine during breastfeeding. A pharmacokinetic model predicts low levels in milk during the newborn period; however, until more information is available, an alternate drug may be preferred.
Drug Levels and Effects > Drug Levels

Maternal Levels. A physiologically based pharmacokinetic model was constructed for oliceridine during the first 24 hours after cesarean delivery. The model predicted an RID between 0.31% and 1.24%, depending on the assumptions that were made about the milk-to-plasma ratio and milk intake.
